hints.title: Drink and Exchange Cycle
hints.text: Initially drink all full bottles, turning them into empty bottles.

hints.title: Exchange While Possible
hints.text: As long as empty bottles count is at least numExchange, exchange them for new full bottles and keep remaining empty bottles.

hints.title: Accumulate Total Drunk
hints.text: Drink newly received bottles, add to drunk count, and add them back to empty bottles pool.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def numWaterBottles(self, numBottles: int, numExchange: int) -> int:
        total = numBottles
        empty = numBottles
        while empty >= numExchange:
            new_bottles = empty // numExchange
            total += new_bottles
            empty = (empty % numExchange) + new_bottles
        return total
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulation loop terminates in logarithmic rounds as empty bottles decrease geometrically.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant extra variables and fast simulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks remaining empty bottles accurately across exchange rounds.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(1) via mathematical formula: numBottles + (numBottles - 1) / (numExchange - 1).
